figurative_meaning_en: A household with five people of diverse or eccentric natures
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমাদের বাড়িটা পাঁচ পাগলের ঘরের মতো, সবাই নিজের মতো করে চলে।
এই অফিসটা পাঁচ পাগলের ঘরের মতো বিশৃঙ্খল।
example_sentences_in_english: Our house is like the house of five madmen, everyone goes their own way.
This office is like a house of five madmen, totally chaotic.
note: Refers to the typical Bengali joint family setup with varied personalities leading to lively disorder.
